description: Singleton row tracking which device profile is currently active on the kiosk. Written only by the POST /api/set-mode Azure Function endpoint; read by the kiosk SPA (GET /api/kiosk-state) and used to tell the panel Pi which logic_maps/<slug>.json to apply. See power pages/GAME_MODE_PLAN.md §4a/§5.

columns.description: Fixed label for the single row, e.g. "Current State" -- this table only ever has one row.
The currently active device. Null = demo/info (dial position 1).
